answer_1.quote: “FAME comprises 128k real data items, including various tasks with singlehop and multi‑hop questions… we incorporate tasks from existing datasets like QA, fact‑check, multi‑hop QA, and introduce new tasks such as cloze and dialogue.”
answer_1.outputs: model‑generated answers to QA, sentence completions, cloze fills, multiple‑choice selections, fact‑check judgments, and dialogue responses

answer_2.quote: “We calculate accuracy by instructing the model to generate responses… The resulting average accuracy is recorded as exact match (EM). We also use drawdown (DD) and Neighborhood KL divergence (NKL) as side‑effect metrics, and introduce SURE to combine accuracy and side effects.”
